title: The Hidden Costs of Building Your Own RAG Stack — Ofer Vectara
talk_summary: Vendor talk on seven hidden costs of DIY RAG: quality/hallucination, latency, scaling cost, security, vendor chaos, maintenance expertise, and multilingual support. It mostly pitches Vectara's managed RAG, but the transferable mechanisms are continuous evals, groundedness scoring, provenance, access control, and end-to-end observability.

takeaways.technique: Continuous regression evals on component changes
takeaways.what_they_do: They argue RAG quality must be evaluated continuously, not just at first deployment, whenever data or components change.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you kind of want to continuously evaluate the results as you add more data refresh the data change components

takeaways.what_they_do: They attach a hallucination score to every query response using an eval model, so users can judge whether the LLM used retrieved facts.
takeaways.evidence_quote: with every call to victara you get your hallucination score
takeaways.numbers: HHEM open-source model >3M downloads; some LLMs hallucinate 10-14%

takeaways.what_they_do: They warn that multi-vendor stacks make diagnosis hard because vendors can point fingers; a harmonized stack with observability is needed.
takeaways.evidence_quote: how do you diagnose issues you have multiple vendors you can have things like you finger pointing

takeaways.what_they_do: They enforce document-level access controls inside the RAG flow so retrieval cannot leak HR/CEO-only or sensitive data.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you want to make sure that your rag stack doesn't leak that information

takeaways.what_they_do: They note retrieval/query latency is not one component but the weakest link in the orchestrated flow.
takeaways.evidence_quote: your system depends on the weakest link

takeaways.what_they_do: They keep an audit trail of source facts so users can click through and verify where a result came from.
takeaways.evidence_quote: your system has to keep the path or the auditorial of where the results came from
